scope: Native Linux ARM64 standalone zune-jpeg; no browser or other ARM64-platform claim
primary: Complete-image Scan36, source output (RGB for YCbCr/native RGB, Luma for gray, CMYK for CMYK), resident and growing input; 32 equal cases, each image 1/16 and source mode 1/2
aggregation: Process T is geometric mean ns/image across primary cases; gain=1-T_candidate/T_control; summary=median process-pair gain
protected: Every individual case, including RGB/RGBA/BGRA Into/Scan36, source scalar Into/Scan36, one-row, raw/YUV, grayscale/native RGB/CMYK and decode()
boundary: Fresh decoder, construction, headers, destination allocation, all retries/rows/finish and destruction. Preloaded input; no output hashing/capture inside timing.
growing: Expose min(4096,length), reveal 16384 only on requested input; no I/O sleeps

build.features: default(std,x86,neon) plus arith; scalar uses set_use_unsafe(false), with actual call-entry verification
build.affinity: Lowest CPU in the runner's allowed affinity set; same for every child

timing.iterations: Fixed per-image counts in corpus.tsv; one untimed warmup per case/process
timing.noise: P95 linear-interpolated abs(1-T_B/T_A) of labeled identical-control process pairs, primary and each protected case separately
timing.CI: 10000 percentile-bootstrap resamples of process pairs, shared indices across cases, seed 535300+session

keep: Primary lower95CI>N in BOTH sessions and every protected upper95slowdownCI<=its own N in BOTH, with verified native execution/dispatch/correctness. Unchanged decoder source is never reported KEEP.
profiling: Own-child GDB, 1000 actual stack samples for each Into/Scan36 x auto/scalar; capped named implementation-entry counts separately, never pointer equality
reporting: Green CI means valid collection/validation only, not a gain. Within-noise results are INCONCLUSIVE; incomplete/empty/error data fails the job. No rerunning populated phases.
smoke: Explicit local smoke only: two pairs, one session, one iteration, no minimum-duration or gain gate; always marked non-performance evidence.
